CT Travel MENA conducted monthly virtual meetings with project partners including International Air Transport Association IATA to analyze the national legal frameworks pertaining to API and PNR systems. The findings are as followsTunisia currently lacks a specific legal decree addressing API and PNR systems. However discussions are ongoing with local authorities to explore the implementation of such a system. Morocco has taken significant steps to regulate the collection and processing of API and PNR data. Article 212 of Law 40.13 mandates air carriers to provide APIPNR data to public authorities for both domestic and international flights. Additionally Morocco has established a national centre overseen by the Director General of National Security to process passenger and flight information. The legal framework emphasizes data security and privacy safeguards. Lebanon has successfully implemented an API and PNR system known as Lebanon iBorders to enhance national security and public safety by monitoring passenger and crew movements. Libya has not yet implemented an APIPNR system. Jordan officially published the API decree in January 2023 adopting an API and PNR departure control system managed by the General Intelligence Directorate GID to screen passengers for potential security threats. Egypt adopted an API and PNRDeparture control system in December 2021 overseen by the Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority ECAA to enhance national security and public safety.

CT Travel MENA conducted monthly virtual meetings with project partners including International Air Transport Association IATA to analyze the national legal frameworks pertaining to API and PNR systems. The findings are as followsTunisia currently lacks a specific legal decree addressing API and PNR systems. However discussions are ongoing with local authorities to explore the implementation of such a system. Morocco has taken significant steps to regulate the collection and processing of API and PNR data. Article 212 of Law 40.13 mandates air carriers to provide APIPNR data to public authorities for both domestic and international flights. Additionally Morocco has established a national centre overseen by the Director General of National Security to process passenger and flight information. The legal framework emphasizes data security and privacy safeguards. Lebanon has successfully implemented an API and PNR system known as Lebanon iBorders to enhance national security and public safety by monitoring passenger and crew movements. Libya has not yet implemented an APIPNR system. Jordan officially published the API decree in January 2023 adopting an API and PNR departure control system managed by the General Intelligence Directorate GID to screen passengers for potential security threats. Egypt adopted an API and PNRDeparture control system in December 2021 overseen by the Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority ECAA to enhance national security and public safety.
